name: Vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactor metabolism
rationale: All members concern synthesis, activation or use of prosthetic cofactors (pyridoxal phosphate, molybdopterin for sulfite oxidation), which separates the theme from confusables centred on methylglyoxal, sulfur amino acid, serine/proline or selenium metabolism.

name: G0 quiescence entry and retinoic acid receptor regulation
rationale: Members cover G1-to-G0 transition, FOXO/p75NTR cell cycle restraint and nuclear (retinoic acid, estrogen) receptor signaling control in differentiation, distinguishing them from E2F/proliferation, thyroid hormone receptor and TP53 arrest confusables.

name: Erythrocyte gas exchange and Rhesus membrane complex
rationale: Members describe red cell O2/CO2/NO transport and the Rh-associated membrane complex (RHAG, Rh biosynthesis), whereas confusables centre on Rh glycoprotein ammonium transport.

qualifier: TCR and TNF receptor superfamily costimulation
name: NF-kB activation in TCR and TNFRSF lymphocyte signaling
rationale: Members combine canonical and non-canonical (NIK) NF-kB activation downstream of TCR, CD27, CD40 and IKK deficiencies with T cell activation and IL-2 output, unlike the innate TLR/NOD/TNFR1 NF-kB confusables or broad B/T cell development confusables.

name: Proteasomal degradation regulation and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members regulate ubiquitin-proteasome turnover and stress granule assembly/disassembly under arsenite and PKR stress, the stress granule and PML body content being what confusables focused on degrons, ERAD and ribosome quality control lack.

name: Vitamin C metabolism, transport and response
rationale: Members concern ascorbate metabolism, dehydroascorbate transport and responses to ascorbate and vitamin E, distinguishing the theme from iron, thyroid hormone, collagen crosslinking and ROS-detoxification confusables.

name: Immediate-early gene induction by TNF and growth factors
rationale: All three gene sets capture rapid stimulus-induced immediate-early genes (NR4A, NF-kB targets, growth arrest genes), unlike confusables about MAPK feedback, UV response, senescence or myeloid inflammatory cytokines.

name: Collagen biosynthesis, crosslinking and elastic fiber assembly
rationale: Members span collagen trimerization, biosynthesis, oxidative crosslinking, fibril and basement membrane assembly plus elastic fibres, the biosynthetic and crosslinking steps being what laminin/integrin, aortic and fibronectin matrix confusables lack.

qualifier: hyaloid vessel regression and programmed cell death
name: Post-embryonic eye maturation with hyaloid vessel regression
rationale: Members describe post-embryonic eye morphogenesis involving apoptotic hyaloid vascular regression, retinal cell death and lens transparency, unlike embryonic eye patterning and retinal neuron differentiation confusables.

name: cAMP/PKA signaling and cyclic nucleotide turnover
rationale: Members cover cAMP synthesis and breakdown (adenylate cyclase, PDE1), PKA activation and cyclic nucleotide responses, distinguishing them from adrenergic Gi, phospholipase C and dopamine/CREB confusables.

core: UV-damage excision repair and translesion synthesis
name: UV-damage excision repair, translesion and telomere C-strand synthesis
rationale: Members are nucleotide excision repair, translesion polymerases, polymerase switching and lagging-strand synthesis including telomere C-strand fill-in, which distinguishes the theme from base excision and mismatch repair confusables.

name: Vitamin A metabolism, phototransduction and photoreceptor development
rationale: Members cover the retinoid cycle and retinoic acid metabolism, opsin phototransduction and its inherited defects, and photoreceptor/retinal neuron development, whereas confusables are lens, cornea, iris and vascular eye development.

name: Neutrophil extravasation and diapedesis
rationale: All members concern neutrophil movement across the endothelium, distinguishing them from monocyte chemotaxis, formyl peptide receptor chemotaxis and leukocyte adhesion confusables.

name: Regulation of osteoblast differentiation and proliferation
rationale: All members regulate osteoblast differentiation or proliferation, unlike chondrocyte, osteoclast and ossification/RUNX2 confusables.

name: Endocannabinoid retrograde signaling and diacylglycerol catabolism
rationale: Members describe lipid retrograde synaptic signaling by endocannabinoids generated from diacylglycerol hydrolysis, unlike glycerolipid biosynthesis and neuropeptide GPCR confusables.

name: Cold and diet-induced thermogenesis via fatty acid uncoupling
rationale: Members concern cold- and diet-induced thermogenesis with fatty acid cycling, fatty acid transport and N-acyl amino acid uncouplers, unlike glycerol transport, carnitine/beta-oxidation and lipolysis confusables.

name: S-phase checkpoint, break-induced replication and genome stability
rationale: Members combine intra-S damage checkpoint, break-induced replication, recombination intermediate resolution and DNA stability control, distinguishing them from replication initiation, fork-reversal and strand-invasion repair confusables.

name: Heme biosynthesis, transport and iron homeostasis
rationale: Members span heme and protoporphyrin biosynthesis, heme scavenging, transferrin and ferroportin iron transport and iron-sulfur assembly, unlike metal-ion, oxygen-sensing and erythrocyte gas-transport confusables.

qualifier: fibroblast migration with TGF-beta stromal genes
name: Fibronectin-integrin focal adhesion and fibroblast migration
rationale: Members link fibronectin matrix formation, integrin synthesis, focal adhesion assembly, SRF cytoskeletal remodeling and fibroblast migration, unlike MET/syndecan adhesion and EMT confusables.

name: Negative regulation of classical complement activation
rationale: All members restrain complement and immunoglobulin-mediated humoral effector activity, whereas every confusable describes complement activation.

name: Mucin-type O-glycosylation and terminal glycan elongation
rationale: Members cover GalNAc-initiated O-glycan synthesis and its defects plus antenna elongation, poly-LacNAc and sialylation, unlike fucosylation/blood group and N-glycan trimming confusables.

name: Methionine-SAM cycle and methionine salvage
rationale: Members are methionine and S-adenosylmethionine metabolism, its enzyme defects and methylthioadenosine salvage, unlike folate, selenium and choline/carnitine confusables.

qualifier: UV, genotoxic drugs and oxidative stress
name: Cellular response to UV, genotoxic drugs and oxidative stress
rationale: Members are responses to UV, bleomycin, cisplatin, hydroperoxide and related stressors, unlike ethanol/anesthetic xenobiotic and liver regeneration confusables.

name: Renal urate and intestinal fructose transport
rationale: Members concern urate handling (URAT1, GLUT9, SLC22) and fructose absorption, distinguishing them from glucose/galactose and cystine/organic cation transport confusables.

qualifier: receptor-mediated pexophagy, mitophagy and autophagosome regulation
name: Receptor-mediated pexophagy, mitophagy and autophagosome regulation
rationale: Members cover cargo targeting in pexophagy, receptor-mediated mitophagy and xenophagy plus regulation of autophagosome assembly and maturation, unlike reticulophagy, aggrephagy/CMA, lysosome fusion and PINK1-PRKN confusables.
